title.narrative: Intra-ACP Global Climate Change Alliance Plus (Part 2)

description.narrative: This action contributes to the GCCA+ flagship initiative and aims to build regional-level capacity to face climate change challenges and a consensus on the necessity to act. The overall objective is to support the sustainable development of the ACP regions and countries by strengthening their resilience to climate change and helping them achieve the UN Sustainable Development Goals, in particular Goal 13 ''Take urgent action to combat climate change and its impacts. In addition, this action will contribute to the implementation of Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs).
